card.name: Just before 'homes' in power-equivalence phrases
card.fires_on: Words just before the noun 'homes' (or households), such as a number, 'million', or a place name, in phrases like 'power 3.5 million homes' or 'windows of local homes'.

modes.label: Energy equivalence
modes.description: Numbers or place names inside 'enough energy to power N homes'.
modes.example: we'd save enough energy to power 3.5<< million>> homes for a year

modes.label: Local homes
modes.description: Words leading into 'homes' in descriptions of effects on residents.
modes.example: Explosions have been powerful enough to rattle the windows of<< local>> homes.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict words like homes, households and families next.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say 'homes' or 'households', especially after a count of homes powered.
